episodes.title: Palace says Marcos to decide on Quiboloy extradition in 'couple of weeks'
episodes.description:
The Malacañang reiterated in a press briefing on Monday, Aug. 10, that the United States' request to extradite detained pastor Apollo Quiboloy must undergo a thorough evaluation, stating President Marcos would weigh the options and make a decision in "a couple of weeks." (Video courtesy of RTVM)

episodes.title: VP Sara defends visits to Duterte, Quiboloy, Tevez, Marcoleta, Estrada, Defensor
episodes.description:
Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday, August 6, defended her visits to several detained political personalities, saying she sees nothing wrong with visiting persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), whom she described as friends.

Citing her visits to former President Rodrigo Duterte, Rodante Marcoleta, Jinggoy Estrada, Mike Defensor, Arnie Teves, and Apollo Quiboloy, VP Sara stressed that PDLs deserve "sympathy."

episodes.description:

episodes.title: Police convoy allegedly carrying Pastor Quiboloy spotted heading to Camp Crame
episodes.description: A police convoy believed to be carrying KOJC Pastor Apollo Quiboloy passed by EDSA-Buendia in Makati City on Sunday night, Sept. 8, 2024. The convoy proceeded directly to the custodial facility at Camp Crame in Quezon City, where the media awaited an official statement from PNP Spokesperson Jean Fajardo. (MB Video by Noel Pabalate)

episodes.title: Marcos: Quiboloy's condition for him to surrender is 'immaterial'
episodes.description:
President Marcos said that the condition laid out by embattled televangelist Pastor Apollo Quiboloy so that he would come out of hiding was "immaterial" and that the government's hands were tied with the arrest warrant issued against him.

episodes.title: Cops, Quiboloy supporters in standoff in Davao City
episodes.description:
Police and supporters of Pastor Apollo Quiboloy are currently locked in a standoff in Davao City on Sunday night, August 25.

As of 10:40 p.m., at least 1,000 Kingdom of Jesus Christ members are holding a protest in front of their compound in Buhangin District.

Police Regional Office-11 chief Police Brig. Gen. Nicolas Torre II  asked the KOJC members to disperse from the Philippines-Japan Friendship Highway.
